scoring_justification: Recompute eigenvalue from agent’s β and Dq, check internal consistency, and verify resulting energy and Δ fall within paper’s reported ranges.

hidden_assets.purpose: Energy range 12000–12500 cm⁻¹ and Δ range -5000 to -4500 cm⁻¹
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'calculate the ⁴T(⁴G) state to be 12000-12500 cm⁻¹' and abstract 'Δ ≈ -4500 to -5000 cm⁻¹'

outputs.description: The agent's computed lowest quartet energy and Δ; the checker will reconstruct the matrix using the reported β and Dq, recompute the lowest eigenvalue, and compare within tolerance, as well as verify the result falls within the physically acceptable range.

output_contract.notes: The agent may choose any Dq within 450–500 cm⁻¹. Only one parameter set is required. The checker recomputes the eigenvalue from the provided β and Dq.
